Thanks for the sync earlier this week. A couple of quick asks to keep the listing timeline on track:

1) Regionalized hero and CTA text: we need US + EU (English + German) + APAC (EN + JP) hero lines and short (1-sentence) supporting blurb for the product page. Character guidance: hero ~ 100 chars, blurb ~ 240 chars.
